title: Onramp Prospectivity Scan & Operational Playbook for Model Landscape Triage
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Objective: Produce a concise operational playbook that converts continuous model-landscape signals into prioritized onramp actions for Hosted, Dedicated, and Private customers. Scope includes: 1) a repeatable prospectivity scoring heuristic combining telemetry (latency/cost), procurement signals (RFPs, partner interest), and model availability fragility; 2) a triage flow that maps scores to specific interventions (probe, pilot, procurement, reserve capacity); 3) templated artifacts (sales-facing one-pager, engineering readiness checklist, procurement trigger matrix). This ticket focuses on analysis method, decision thresholds, and runbook drafts for Q2 trials.
acceptance_criteria: Scoring heuristic documented with data inputs and weight rationale
Triage flowchart (PDF) with clear thresholds for probe/pilot/procurement/reserve actions
Three templated artifacts produced: sales one-pager, eng readiness checklist, procurement trigger matrix
Pilot plan for two verticals (FinServ, SMB SaaS) with success metrics and timeline
